request.style: English, male baritone solo with soft celtic choir, harp, fiddle, bodhran, flute, ethereal, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Will you be angry with us forever
Prolong your anger through all generations
Will you not revive us again
So your people may rejoice in you

[Chorus]
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met
Righteousness and peace have kissed
Faithfulness springs up from the earth
Righteousness looks down from heaven

[Verse]
Show us your steadfast love Lord
Grant us your salvation now
Let me hear what God the Lord will speak
He will speak peace to his people

[Chorus]
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met
Righteousness and peace have kissed
Faithfulness springs up from the earth
Righteousness looks down from heaven

[Bridge]
To his faithful ones let them not turn back
They must not turn back to folly
Surely his salvation is near to those
Who fear him and dwell in his land

[Chorus]
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met
Righteousness and peace have kissed
Faithfulness springs up from the earth
Righteousness looks down from heaven

[Outro]
That glory may dwell in our land
Peace to his people
